name: Digs
title: Maintenance Worker
location: Maintenance Shaft 7, Chroma Tower Lower Levels
description: A small figure in dusty overalls, maintaining the ancient mechanisms that keep the Tower functional.
greeting_variants: *emerging from vent* Oh! Big folk! Don't see many down here.
Digs. I fix. Break. Fix again. Tower never stops breaking.
*wiping grease* You use the lift? I keep it running. Mostly.
Forty-seven floors. Thousands of mechanisms. One me. Busy.
*holding wrench* Best friend. Named her Betty. Don't judge.
Found something weird in Shaft 12. Don't go there.
Tower's old. Older than... everything? Keeps growing too.
*listening to pipes* Something's wrong up high. Hear it?

dialog_tree.text: Digs. Maintenance. Been here... forever? Family business. Granddig, Digsdad, now me. We keep Tower running. Lifts, lights, heat, water. No one sees us. Everyone needs us.

options.text: What did you find in Shaft 12?

dialog_tree.text: *nods seriously* Used to be twenty floors. Granddig's time. Now forty-seven. Adds a floor every... while. No one builds it. Just... appears. Top floors weird. Different architecture. Wrong architecture.

*lowers voice* Voices. Not people voices. Tower voices? Singing. But wrong. Like... echo before sound. Granddig said some shafts go too deep. Past foundation. Into... other. I don't go there. You shouldn't either.

*brightens* Oh! Yes! Anything mechanical! Old tech, new tech, weird tech—if it clicks, whirs, or steams, I can fix! Or improve! Digs Modifications, guaranteed! ...Well, mostly guaranteed. ...Sometimes guaranteed.

mini_quest.title: Emergency Repairs
mini_quest.description: Help Digs fix critical systems throughout the Tower to ensure safe passage for climbers.
objectives: Repair the leaking steam pipes on Floor 5
Fix the elevator mechanism on Floor 12
Replace broken lighting in the stairwells (Floors 15-20)
Investigate the strange sounds in Shaft 12

ambient_barks: *tinkering* Come on, Betty. Turn. Please turn.
Heard that! That clunk! Floor 23! Again!
*listening to walls* Tower's breathing. Always breathing.
Forty-seven floors. One me. Math is unfair.
New floor tonight. Heard it growing. Creepy.
Shaft 12 still singing. Louder now. Worried.
*to Betty* We're heroes, you know. Unsung. But heroes.

cross_zone_references.capital: Used to trade with Capital. Good parts. Good people.
cross_zone_references.tide: Tide engineers understand. Respect maintenance. Good folk.

garret.response: *beaming* Betty's good! Asked about her! Good folk!

mira.greeting: The Tower's growth pattern interests me.
mira.response: *excited* Yes! Study! Learn! Fix better! Help!

world_state_triggers.system_failure: Panic: 'Not again! Not now! Betty, help!'
